name: Deploy & Compile Current RPGLE File
command: system "CRTBNDRPG PGM(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&FULLPATH') DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)"

name: Deploy & Compile Current DSPF File
command: system "CPYFRMSTMF FROMSTMF('&FULLPATH') TOMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&CURLIB.LIB/QDDSSRC.FILE/&NAME.MBR') MBROPT(*REPLACE)" && system "CRTDSPF FILE(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&CURLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(&NAME) REPLACE(*YES) LVLCHK(*NO)"
